lines.text: Solomon's carriage comes up from the wilderness, escorted by sixty mighty men of Israel, each with a sword.
Solomon made his carriage from the timber of Lebanon, and his mother crowned him on his wedding day.
He calls her darling and says her hair is like goats streaming down Mount Carmel.
He calls her from Lebanon, says one glance captured his heart, and says her love is better than oil.
The north and south winds are called to breathe on the garden, and friends are told to eat and drink.
